sentences.en: Lev Kuleshov showed an audience a short film featuring a famous actor.

sentences.en: The footage of the actor was always the same,
sentences.zh: 演员的镜头始终是一样的，

sentences.en: a single, unmoving, and entirely neutral expression.
sentences.zh: 是一个单一、静止且完全中性的表情。

sentences.en: But the filmmaker intercut the shot with three different images,
sentences.zh: 但这位电影制作人将这个镜头与三幅不同的图像剪辑在一起，

sentences.en: a bowl of hot soup, a child in a coffin, and a woman reclining on a sofa.
sentences.zh: 一碗热汤、棺材里的孩子，以及躺在沙发上的女人。

sentences.en: Even though the actor's face never changed,

sentences.en: the audience was mesmerized by his performance.

sentences.en: When paired with the soup, they saw a man gripped by hunger.

sentences.en: When paired with the coffin, they saw a face transformed by grief.

sentences.en: They didn't see a sequence of unrelated pictures.

他们看到的是一个完整的故事。

sentences.en: The human brain is wired to make connections like this.

sentences.en: We want to see the frames as part of a narrative.
